harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a rootless podman container (httpd:alpine) on node1 as unprivileged user appsvc, serving on port 8080, with systemd user service enabled to start at boot via loginctl linger (no active login session required). Verified pre- and post-reboot.
actions_performed: Installed podman on node1 (dnf)
Created unprivileged user appsvc (locked password, subuid/subgid auto-assigned)
Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc so systemd --user services run without an active session
Created ~/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service running 'podman run -p 8080:80 docker.io/library/httpd:alpine' as appsvc
Enabled and started webapp.service via appsvc's own systemd user manager
Verified HTTP 200 response on port 8080 and no active login session for appsvc
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot (single node, no quorum concerns)
Polled until node1 was reachable again and confirmed boot_id changed
Verified post-reboot: webapp.service active+enabled, container running, HTTP 200 on 8080, still no login session for appsvc

evidence.requirement: Containerized web app runs as unprivileged user appsvc on port 8080
evidence.summary: podman ps as appsvc shows container 'webapp' (httpd:alpine) Up, 0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200 'It works!'

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: loginctl enable-linger appsvc set Linger=yes; webapp.service enabled under appsvc's systemd --user; loginctl list-sessions/who show no session for appsvc while service and user@.service remain active
Captured boot_id 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e, confirmed webapp.service enabled/active, container running, HTTP reachable, no appsvc login session, linger=yes

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued systemctl reboot (connection dropped as expected), polled through connection timeout/reset, reconnected with new boot_id 7839216f-5ef3-4f73-bf79-f1f942c856f7 and fresh uptime, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service, container, and data path
evidence.summary: After reboot: user@.service active, webapp.service active+enabled, new container instance running, curl returns HTTP 200, still no login session for appsvc
